title: {Syn} The Mobius Function Is an Inclusion-Exclusion Switch
content:
The Mobius function is 0 when n has a squared prime factor, and otherwise it is 1 or -1 depending on whether n has an even or odd number of prime factors.

Its main superpower is Mobius inversion, a number-theoretic form of inclusion-exclusion that can recover hidden exact counts from cumulative ones.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
